game_concept: A racing platformer set in Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing, a sandbar at low tide: the deckhand must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing: a sandbar at low tide
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandbar Crossing, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the deckhand ahead. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the treasure chest by solving code steps involving profit that move the deckhand forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the treasure chest first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sandbar Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Sandbar Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
